report.explanation: All current evidence is healthy: gateway checkout trace OK at 65ms, p95 71ms, error rate 0.14%, zero db pool waiters and dependency timeouts, INFO/OK 200 logs for gateway and order. The order deployment record only proves version facts and cannot establish causation. No evidence supports any taxonomy root cause, so hand off rather than assert one.
missing_evidence: Telemetry showing an actual checkout failure or elevated error rate aligned to the alert window

Logs or traces exhibiting errors rather than INFO/OK 200 responses
Evidence linking order 3.2.6 deployment to any observed degradation
